Act14-3#1.zh: 来来，各位不要客气，尽量喝！
Act14-3#1.t: Come, come, don't stand on ceremony, everyone. Drink up!

Act14-3#2.zh: 王头领，有关我们入伙的事...？

Act14-3#3.zh: 众位豪杰特定到此来聚义，只恨敝山小寨是一洼之水，哪里容得下这么多真龙？在下准备一些小礼物，当作盘缠；请你们另投名山大寨，做一番事业。
Act14-3#3.t: You heroes have come especially to join us, but sadly our little stronghold is a mere puddle. How could it hold so many true dragons? I've prepared some small gifts for your travels; please seek out some greater mountain stronghold and make your name there.

Act14-3#4.zh: 在下久闻梁山招贤纳士，所以特地率领同伙相投；既然王头领无法收容我等，那么我等应当自行告退。王头领所赐之黄金白银，决不敢拿；并非我敢自夸，我等还有点盘缠可用。请王头领收回金银，我等就此告别。
Act14-3#4.t: I had long heard that Liangshan welcomes worthy men, so I brought my companions to join you. Since Chief Wang cannot take us in, we should take our leave. We would never dare accept the gold and silver you offer; not to boast, but we have some travel money of our own. Please take it back, and we'll say goodbye.

Act14-3#5.zh: 何必推托？不是敝山不接纳众位豪杰，只是山寨粮少房稀，恐怕会误了足下的前途，毁了诸位的威名。休怪，休怪。
Act14-3#5.t: Why refuse? It's not that we won't have you heroes; our stronghold is short of grain and houses, and I fear it would hold back your future and tarnish your fame. Forgive me, forgive me.

Act14-3#6.zh: 只见吴用把手来拈髭须。
Act14-3#6.t: Wu Yong was seen stroking his beard.

Act14-3#7.zh: 就算梁山粮少房稀，并非没有解决的方法！山寨中粮食短少，可以到四邻村镇去借；山场水泊，树木茂盛，要盖千间房屋也没有问题。这分明是拿藉口赶我们下山！我们千里投名、万里投主；林冲虽然不才，如果头领肯收留，当以一死向前，实为平生之幸。我不是为了要些许的金银而来，而你却想用钱财把我们打发下山？岂不小看了我？！
Act14-3#7.t: Even if Liangshan is short of grain and houses, there are ways round that! If the stronghold lacks grain, borrow it from the villages and towns around. The hills and marshes are thick with trees; building a thousand houses would be no problem. This is plainly an excuse to drive us down the mountain! We've come a thousand li to join a worthy name and ten thousand li to find a master. Untalented as I am, Lin Chong, if the Chief would take me in, I'd charge ahead at the cost of my life and count it the luck of my life. I didn't come for a bit of gold and silver, yet you'd try to pay us off and send us down the mountain? Do you take me so lightly?!

Act14-3#8.zh: 无礼！我毕竟也是堂堂一山寨之主，岂能让你撒野？！喔...你就是那个『豹子头』林冲啊...你的通缉令已经从东京贴到这附近，官府的每一个人都想要你的项上人头换取功名！你想我能收留你这个祸害吗？！
Act14-3#8.t: How rude! I am the master of this stronghold, after all; I won't let you run wild here! Oh... so you're that 'Panther Head' Lin Chong... Your warrant is posted all the way from the Eastern Capital to these parts. Every official wants your head to buy his promotion! You think I'd take in trouble like you?!

Act14-3#9.t: (Oh no, Lin Chong's about to blow up again...)

Act14-3#10.zh: 你不过是个没考上功名的穷书生，胸中又没丝毫学问，怎么做得了山寨之主！
Act14-3#10.t: You're nothing but a poor scholar who failed the exams, with not a shred of learning in you. How can you be master of a stronghold!

Act14-3#12.zh: 林教头！不要为了我们坏了大义！
Act14-3#12.t: Instructor Lin! Don't break with honour for our sake!

Act14-3#13.zh: 这是个笑里藏刀之人！我今日绝对不放过他！
Act14-3#13.t: This man hides a knife behind his smile! I won't let him off today!

Act14-3#14.zh: 哈哈哈...嘲笑我没什么本事？可是今天你们却会死在这么个考不上功名的穷书生手下！我好意想花些路费请你们走，你们却敬酒不吃吃罚酒！喽罗们，动手！
Act14-3#14.t: Hahaha... mocking me for having no skill? Yet today you'll die at the hands of this poor scholar who failed the exams! I kindly offered you travel money to leave, and you'd rather have the punishment than the toast! Men, at them!

Act14-3#15.zh: 你这嫉贤妒能的贼，不杀了要你何用！你也无大量之才，也做不得山寨之主！
Act14-3#15.t: You thief, jealous of the worthy and the able! What use are you alive! You haven't the breadth to lead, and you're no fit master of a stronghold!

Act14-3#16.zh: 一场血战，即将拉开战幕。。。
Act14-3#16.t: A bloody battle is about to begin...
